study: Allen et al. 2015 (My Teaching Partner-Secondary [MTP-S], JREE 8(4))
eval_evidence: Authored by the MTP developers (Pianta, Allen); explicit conflict-of-interest note: Robert Pianta is co-owner of the company charged with disseminating MyTeachingPartner. Developer-conducted evaluation.
developer_evidence: Master-teacher coaches 'from the research team who were trained in the CLASS-S' served as the primary coaches 'responsible for implementing' the MTP-S intervention.
cascade_evidence: Research-team master-teacher coaches delivered the web-mediated coaching directly to participating teachers; no separate trained intermediary tier.
counterfactual_evidence: Control group received business-as-usual in-service professional development (per design/extraction).
coaching_evidence: Web-mediated video coaching cycles tied to teachers' own classroom recordings, but intensity was reduced in this replication to ~5-6 coaching cycles per year (vs. 10-12 in the original) -- roughly every 6-7 weeks, below the monthly/biweekly anchor for frequent_inclass; also remote rather than in-person in-class.
student_dose_evidence: Teacher-coaching intervention only; only the teacher's own instruction changes. No tutoring/pull-out/added student dose.
maturity_evidence: Two-year intervention; achievement measured at end of Year 2 for the single cohort of teachers new to MTP-S (the program's first/only run for them, no prior implementation year).
